This '''species''' was a [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] that existed in [[the galaxy]].<ref name="TROS" />

==Biology and appearance==
This [[Sentience|sentient]] [[humanoid]] [[species]] was distinguished by their blue skin,<ref name="TROS" /> yellow eyes,<ref name="Kijimi" /> and the jagged growths protruding from their cranium.<ref name="TROS" />

==Species in the galaxy==
In [[35 ABY]],<ref name="TROSDate">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of ''Star Wars'': Episode IX ''The Rise of Skywalker'' to [[35 ABY]].</ref> a member of this species was present on the planet [[Kijimi]] shortly before its destruction.<ref name="TROS" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Unidentified-Jagged-Cranial-Spike-Species-Sculpt.png|thumb|right|250px|This species' head sculpt in-progress]]
The species made their debut in the [[2019]] film ''[[Star Wars: Episode IX The Rise of Skywalker]]'', directed by [[J.J. Abrams]].<ref name="TROS" /> This species was originally designed by concept artist [[Ivan Manzella]],<ref name="Manzella">{{WebCite|url=https://www.krop.com/ivanmanzella|text=Ivan Manzella Creatures & Character Designs|author=Manzella, Ivan|work=[https://www.krop.com Krop]|archivedate=20190121223617}}</ref> with their design expanded upon by outfit artist [[Calum Alexander Watt]].<ref name="CAW">{{Instagram|username=calumalexanderwatt|url=p/CAnSAUtHm5L|name=[[Calum Alexander Watt]]|date=2020-05-25|quote=From The Art of Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker. Costume concept art for Kijimi crowd, Big Collar 2018. Creature design by Ivan Manzella. Alternate options for same creature. We were given full access to most of the sets on TRoS and it's a great help to visit and experience the environment the characters will be inhabiting. By the time this design came about, Kijimi set was almost done and set-dressed, a rack of alien fish inspired this hunter type. Perhaps this is a native of Kijimi? The collar here a section of a giant tusk maybe? The scrimshaw carve-work sharing the same typography as Zorii and her gang. The creature department would create prosthetics and the collar for this creature so it needed to be incorporated into the costume. The chosen version was taking the concept of John Mollo padding to the extreme! The collar did change to a more angular version, and this guy can be seen in Zorii's bar walkthrough. I'm glad they kept the uplighting in the collar! #StarWars #TheRiseOfSkywalker #costumedesign #concept #conceptart|archiveurl=https://ghostarchive.org/archive/VfSQd}}</ref>
